sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Ollamh Fódhla is a legendary Irish king. Stories say he claimed the high seat of Tara in about 714 B.C.E. He was the first to codify the law of the land. The name Ollamh is read as poet of Fódla, a goddess of Ireland's land. Poets held the office of brehon, another word for judge. So Ollamh may have served as a judge before the kingship.

okr.objective: Ollamh Fódhla is the legendary king who first codified Irish law.
